lightdust.config.title: Light Dust Settings
lightdust.config.ambient_radius.tooltip: How far from the player dust particles can spawn (in blocks)
lightdust.config.hard_cap_radius.tooltip: Particles beyond this distance are removed
lightdust.config.block_cap.tooltip: Maximum number of particles per block position
lightdust.config.min_block_light.tooltip: Minimum light level required to spawn dust
lightdust.config.daytime_light_diff.tool: During daytime, block light must exceed sky light by this amount
lightdust.config.falloff_distance.toolti: Distance at which particle density starts to decrease
lightdust.config.falloff_multiplier.tool: Particle density multiplier beyond the falloff distance (lower = fewer)
lightdust.config.occlusion_culling.toolt: Skip spawning particles behind walls the player can't see
lightdust.config.dust_opacity.tooltip: Base transparency of ambient dust particles
lightdust.config.particle_size.tooltip: Visual size of each dust particle
lightdust.config.particle_lifetime.toolt: How long each particle lives (in ticks, 20 = 1 second)
lightdust.config.disable_rain.tooltip: Stop spawning dust outdoors when it's raining
lightdust.config.disable_thunder.tooltip: Stop spawning dust outdoors during thunderstorms
lightdust.config.interact_radius.tooltip: How close the player must be to push dust around
lightdust.config.break_count.tooltip: Number of dust particles spawned when a block is broken
lightdust.config.break_speed.tooltip: How fast dust flies out from a broken block
lightdust.config.action_gravity.tooltip: Gravity strength on action dust (block break, landing)
lightdust.config.action_bounce.tooltip: How much action dust bounces off the ground
lightdust.config.landing_max.tooltip: Maximum dust particles from a heavy landing
lightdust.config.landing_multiplier.tool: Multiplied by fall distance to determine particle count
lightdust.config.landing_upward.tooltip: How high dust launches upward on impact
lightdust.config.landing_outward.tooltip: How far dust spreads outward on impact
lightdust.config.landing_push.tooltip: How much nearby ambient dust gets pushed by impact
lightdust.config.landing_radius.tooltip: Radius of ambient dust affected by heavy landing
lightdust.config.dust_settling.tooltip: Dust particles stop moving when they land on blocks
lightdust.config.entity_disturbance.tool: Nearby moving entities push dust particles around
lightdust.config.entity_push.tooltip: How strongly moving entities push dust particles
lightdust.config.tint_strength.tooltip: How strongly light sources tint nearby dust color
